title: Modrinth Mod (ModUpdaterFabric)
description: Download Mods, Shaders, Resourcepacks While InGame !! Additionally, Downloads and applies mod updates Automatically . Fast and Efficient. Uses High performance Algorithm to fetch Updates with low performance cost.
body:
# Mod Updater
Bored of downloading updates manually ?

ModUpdaterFabric is a lightweight, highly optimized Fabric client mod that automatically checks, downloads, and applies mod updates directly from Modrinth without ever leaving the game.

![Download Screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/gQLEXRSG/images/35b9b8ee9c27edde2a3a989f192f86fc72a6d39b.png)
![update](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/gQLEXRSG/images/26677f63e0fd0ca4f01e73a7c965e1f9707bfae2.png)
![Confirm Screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/gQLEXRSG/images/eebd0f499dbbc3de12becc4ea426b363fe5f48fd.png)


## ✨ Features

- **Lightning Fast Checks:** Checks 100+ mods within a second.
 
- **100% Accuracy:** Uses perfect version matching and can update various mods available on Modrith.

- **Native Mod Menu Integration:** Check and Download update with Simple UI.
 
- **Parallel Downloading:** Safely handles updates with a multi-threaded asynchronous download manager and live progress tracking.
 
- **Apply Updates:** Apply downloaded Update Automatically just by pressing one button.

## 📦 Requirements

- **Minecraft:** 26.1+
- **Fabric Loader:** >= 0.19.2
- **Java:** 25

### Dependencies

Ensure these mods are in your `mods/` folder alongside this one:

- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)
- [Yet Another Config Lib (YACL)](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl)

## ⚠️ Important Note

**Client-Side Only!** Do not install this mod on a dedicated server. It utilizes client-side GUI elements and modifies local machine files. It will cause a server crash on startup.
